en.headline: Housing Secretary Winnie Ho resigns as Wang Fuk fire report released
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee accepted the resignation with immediate effect and named Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong to act as housing secretary after officials bowed at a press conference.
body: Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho resigned on Thursday to take political responsibility for the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po, and Chief Executive John Lee accepted the resignation with immediate effect. Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong is acting as housing secretary.

Lee and other principal officials held a press conference at the Central Government Offices after the government released the independent committee’s report into the fire that killed 168 people, including one firefighter, on 26 November last year. The officials bowed and Lee apologised on behalf of the government.

The report, prepared after about nine months of work and 30 days of hearings, examines the causes of the fire and regulatory failings involving the Housing Bureau’s Independent Checking Unit, the Fire Services Department, the Buildings Department and the Labour Department. The government said it would pursue accountability through ongoing criminal cases, administrative processes and political responsibility, and would introduce measures including legislation against bid-rigging and stronger oversight of building maintenance works.

Lee said the government would carefully study the recommendations and announce a comprehensive reform plan. The independent committee was established in December last year and submitted its report to the Chief Executive last week.

zh.headline: 房屋局局長何永賢請辭 宏福苑火災報告公布
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超接納何永賢即時請辭，由財政司副司長黃偉紎署理房屋局局長；官員在記者會上鞠躬致歉。
body: 房屋局局長何永賢周四承擔政治責任請辭，行政長官李家超接納請辭，即時生效。財政司副司長黃偉紎署理房屋局局長。
李家超聯同多位主要官員在政府總部舉行記者會，公布獨立委員會就大埔宏福苑火災的調查報告。該場火災於去年11月26日發生，造成168人死亡，包括一名消防員。官員在會上鞠躬，李家超代表政府致歉。
報告經約九個月工作及30日聽證會後完成，檢視火災成因，並指出房屋局獨立檢查組、消防處、屋宇署及勞工處的監管問題。政府表示會透過正在進行的刑事案件、行政問責及政治問責追究責任，並會推行包括將圍標刑事化及加強樓宇維修工程監管等措施。
李家超表示政府會仔細研究建議，短期內公布全面改革計劃。獨立委員會於去年12月成立，上周已向行政長官提交報告。
